credit: Built in DreamCut as an editable code-built 3D motion graphic; no footage, generated imagery or people.
teachingNote: The default city scene at normal speed: it draws in for 1.6 s, then the camera flies for 4 s.

receipt.construction: Rendered with HyperFrames from .agents/skills/motion-graphics/templates/sketch-3d (index.html, scene.js and dreamcut.controls.json defaults). Encoded to H.264 1280x720 (CRF 31, no audio). Poster is the frame at 2.6 s; stages are frames of the same render at 0.8, 2.6 and 3.8 s. inputs/scenes.jpg is the same engine with a different scene.js (tower, sphere, block, forest, extruded arrow, ground grid) at 3.5 s.
